name: Trans and gender diverse peer group
description: A facilitated group for trans and gender diverse people. Come as often or as rarely as you like, and there is no need to speak.

name: Finding a GP who gets it, workshop
description: What to ask a practice before you book, how to read an accreditation, and what to do when a provider is not right for you.

name: Over 50s connection group
description: A relaxed group for LGBTIQ+ people over 50, including people living with HIV. Tea, conversation, and a guest speaker once a month.

name: For families and allies, an evening session
description: For parents, partners and friends. How to support someone without taking over, and where to put your own questions.

name: Trans and gender diverse peer group
description: The September session of our monthly peer group. New faces welcome, and you can arrive late or leave early.

name: Browsing safely on a shared device
description: Private windows, clearing history, checking what your browser has saved, and what a quick exit button can and cannot do.

name: Living well with HIV over 50
description: A community forum with an HIV physician and peer navigators. Bring questions, anonymously if you would rather.

name: Volunteer induction
description: For anyone who has registered interest in volunteering. What the roles involve, and the training that comes with them.

name: Health information in community languages
description: Interpreters available in Arabic, Greek, Mandarin and Vietnamese. Plain language health information and time to ask questions.

name: First Nations yarning circle
description: A yarning circle for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander LGBTIQA+ community members, facilitated by an Aboriginal Health Worker.

name: Trans and gender diverse peer group
description: The November session. The group runs on the second Thursday of every month.

name: Summer community picnic
description: An outdoor get together for everyone we work with, families and allies included. Shade, seating and accessible toilets on site.
